   SUM(CASE WHEN status='已签收' AND received_at IS NOT NULL AND received_at<>'' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) signed,
   MAX(received_at) last_at FROM shipments GROUP BY sales_order_id)
SELECT
 (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM v_current_orders o JOIN lr ON lr.sales_order_id=o.sales_order_id WHERE lr.signed=lr.batches AND lr.last_at LIKE '2026-09-17%') AS delivered_0917,
 (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT work_order_id) FROM exceptions WHERE opened_at LIKE '2026-09-17%') AS new_wo,
 (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT work_order_id) FROM exceptions WHERE opened_at<='2026-09-17T23:59:59+08:00' AND (closed_at IS NULL OR closed_at='' OR closed_at>'2026-09-17T23:59:59+08:00')) AS open_eod,
 (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT expense_id) FROM expenses WHERE submitted_at LIKE '2026-09-17%') AS reimb_cnt,
 (SELECT ROUND(SUM(amount),2) FROM expenses WHERE submitted_at LIKE '2026-09-17%') AS reimb_amt,
 (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM v_current_orders) AS eff,
 (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM v_current_orders o JOIN lr ON lr.sales_order_id=o.sales_order_id WHERE lr.signed=lr.batches) AS signed_total,
 (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM v_current_orders o LEFT JOIN lr ON lr.sales_order_id=o.sales_order_id WHERE lr.sales_order_id IS NULL OR lr.signed<lr.batches) AS unfinished,
